name: spims
description: Smart Pharmacy Inventory Management System — root quality-gate scripts

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --prefix server && npm run lint:fix --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:ci --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.audit: npm run audit --prefix server && npm run audit --prefix client
scripts.audit:all: npm run audit:all --prefix server && npm run audit:all --prefix client
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.check:ci: npm run check && npm run audit
